annotations.title: Solar terms and Lunar New Year for a year

description: All 24 solar terms (节气) of a year with their exact local date and time, plus the date of Lunar New Year (春节) and the new zodiac year. Covers questions like 'when is Chinese New Year 2027', 'when is the winter solstice', 'when does spring start in the Chinese calendar', '二十四节气'. Local times use the location the client shares when no city is given.

city.description: Optional. City name. Omit to use the user's location.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone. Omit to use the user's location.

name: get_solar_terms
